name: Lost&Found
source:
You play as "Gale" (name is customisable), an almost 30-year-old drifting through life with no purpose, whose only passion in life is being a superfan to their favourite actor. The stars align, leading them directly to the one person they’ve been fawning over for all these years. Will Gale take this chance to change the trajectory of their orbit, or will they crumble under the gravity of it all?

[Edited from [url=https://chouchoutrains.itch.io/lostandfound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演“Gale”（名字可定制），一个近30岁的年轻人，漫无目的地漂流，生活中唯一的热情就是成为他们最喜欢的演员的超级粉丝。星星排成一排，将他们直接引向他们多年来一直奉承的那个人。盖尔会利用这个机会改变他们的轨道轨迹，还是他们会在这一切的重力下崩溃？

[编辑自[url=https://chouchoutrains.itch.io/lostandfound]itch.io[/url]]
